pages.text: An end-game machine built in slices. One slice is 1 wide, 2 high and 3 long. Put blanks in the Blank Hatch and RF in the Power Port, both at the back.$(br2)Pressing takes real time, from hours to days by tier, and carries on while you are offline. Coins collect in the tray and must be taken by hand.$(br2)Stuck on a build? Empty your hand and $(l)sneak + right-click$() the controller for the step-by-step Assembly Guide.

pages.title: Factory slice
pages.text: Bottom from the front: Controller, Frame, Blank Hatch. Top: Frame, Press, Power Port.

Build slices side by side, facing the same way, and they join into one machine with one screen. You may own up to 10 slices.$(br2)Each slice presses its own blanks. RF is shared, and cabling more Power Ports charges the machine faster.
